name: COIN PUSHER [Alpha1.1]
desc:
🆕 July 24, 2025 Update 🆕
📖 A new encyclopedia feature for Collectibles has been added! 📖
Aim for a full collection—good luck! 
Who will be the first to snag those rare items? 😍

🌟 July 16, 2025 Update Log 🌟
❤️ New Feature: Collectibles Now Available! ❤️
⚓️ Collectibles now drop during Coin Pusher gameplay!
💰 Trade the coins you’ve saved for exciting Collectibles!

⚡️ Got a super rare Collectible? Flaunt it and make everyone jealous! ⚡️

Thanks to everyone who participated in the survey—your feedback made this happen!

✨️Past Updates✨️
We’ve revamped and updated the in-game visuals.
Increased slot machine win rate!
More cannonballs will appear during gameplay!
Reduced the number of coins needed to exchange for pets!

Throw coins and push them off to win more!

🧍Play solo for fun!
🧑‍🤝‍🧑Team up with a friend for better efficiency and more coins!
🐙Something mysterious awaits beyond the pirate ship…
🐬Collect lots of coins and trade them for adorable pets!
